description: This PHP source file handles the deletion of a lead conversion mapping in the vtiger CRM system. It purifies and retrieves a parameter 'cfmid' from the request, executes a DELETE SQL query to remove the mapping with that ID, and then redirects the user back to the custom field list page.

methods.name: vtlib_purify
methods.description: Sanitizes input data to prevent security vulnerabilities.

methods.name: $adb->pquery
methods.description: Prepares and executes a parameterized SQL query.
